prompt: 帮我给一个叫 Aether 的开发者工具做静态产品官网。要有落地页、数据页和关于页，落地页展示最新动态和核心指标，数据页放完整数据，关于页写清楚产品、作者和免责声明。数据用本地 JSON，默认中英文、支持深浅主题和跟随系统，部署到 GitHub Pages。请给出项目结构、关键代码、logo 方案和截图计划。
assertions: Project has landing, data, about and /en/ page files
product.json and derived highlights.json both exist
Theme tokens and zh/en dictionaries are present
SEO/GEO files include canonical, hreflang, sitemap and llms.txt
SVG and PNG logo plus GitHub Pages workflow exist
README and a screenshot plan are present
